citation: Pillow, Shlens, Paninski, Sher, Litke, Chichilnisky & Simoncelli, Nature 454:995-999, 2008
conditioning: gct+lct through an MLP producing a per-clip log-rate offset; gct additionally via the per-assay site baseline
notes: Translation-invariant coupling: one shared kernel K[lag,dh,dw] instead of per-neuron filters, which a 26,880-channel array at 1.55e-4 rate cannot support. K[:,0,0] is the history filter.

regimes.random: gct and lct both drawn unconditionally from the train bank
regimes.global_only: gct pinned; lct retrieved conditioned on gct
regimes.global_partial_local: gct pinned; ['log_mean_firing_density', 'active_site_ratio'] pinned exactly; rest retrieved
regimes.global_full_local: gct and lct both pinned to the held-out clip
